# Keeping `bug:triage` and `bug:ready` as the triage labels

In Section B (triage label vocabulary), the maintainer should answer **no** to "keep the default triage labels?" and then supply overrides for the roles that already have labels. The setup records a mapping from each canonical role to a label string. `triage` then applies the existing labels instead of creating new ones.

## 1. Map the existing labels to canonical roles

The five canonical roles are `needs-triage`, `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, and `wontfix`.

| Canonical role | Label string |
|---|---|
| `needs-triage` | `bug:triage` |
| `ready-for-agent` **or** `ready-for-human` | `bug:ready` |
| `needs-info` | `needs-info` (default) |
| the other "ready" role | its default name |
| `wontfix` | `wontfix` (default) |

`bug:triage` clearly maps to `needs-triage`. `bug:ready` is ambiguous. It should map to whichever "ready" role matches how the team works:

- Map it to `ready-for-agent` if "ready" means an agent can pick the issue up.
- Map it to `ready-for-human` if "ready" means a person will implement it.

The maintainer should make that call. Mapping `bug:ready` to both roles is a bad idea, because `triage` would then be unable to tell the two states apart.

Any role without an existing equivalent keeps its default name.

## 2. Record the mapping

The mapping goes into `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`. For example, if `bug:ready` means agent-ready:

```markdown
| Role            | Label        |
|-----------------|--------------|
| needs-triage    | bug:triage   |
| needs-info      | needs-info   |
| ready-for-agent | bug:ready    |
| ready-for-human | ready-for-human |
| wontfix         | wontfix      |
```

The `## Agent skills` block in `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` gets a one-line summary under `### Triage labels`, such as "Custom mapping: `bug:triage` / `bug:ready`, other roles default." It also points to `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`.

## 3. Why this avoids duplicates

When Section B runs on GitHub or GitLab, the setup only creates configured labels that the tracker **lacks**:

- `bug:triage` and `bug:ready` already exist, so they're left alone. No `needs-triage` or `ready-for-agent` label gets created next to them.
- Only the unmapped defaults that don't already exist would be created, such as `needs-info`, `wontfix`, and the other "ready" label. If the maintainer has existing equivalents for those too (for example `bug:wontfix`), they should map them the same way so nothing new is created.

After setup, the mapping can be changed later by editing `docs/agents/triage-labels.md` directly. Re-running the setup isn't required.
